title: human_plasma
description: We adapted the NextGen sequencing technology to obtain more accurate spectra of mRNA and miRNA in circulation, specifically to explore the plasma-miRNA association with colorectal cancer and ulcerative colitis.

samples.title: SM6_uc1
samples.description: Protocols: The plasma was prepared from EDTA blood by centrifugation at 1,0006g for 15 minutes to separate the plasma and blood cells. Total RNA from plasma was extracted from 100 ml of the sample using the miRNeasy kit (Qiagen, Valencia, CA). The quality and quantity of the RNA were evaluated with Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer (Santa Clara, CA) and NanoDrop 1000 spectrophotometer (Thermo Scientific, Wilmington, DE). In average, we obtained about 100 ng of RNA per ml of plasma. As a control we also obtained total RNA from Ambion (Life Technologies, Carlsbad, CA). NextGen sequencing libraries were prepared with small RNA sample preparation kits from Illumina (Illumina, San Diego, CA).
